title: AI Emergency Alerts Are Coming. Humans Might Not Be Ready
summary: Human beings struggle with emergency communication. Chatbots can help—if people take them seriously.
llm_summary: AI-driven emergency alerts are on the horizon, promising faster, more precise warnings than traditional systems. However, people often ignore or misunderstand crisis messages, so the success of these chat‑based alerts will hinge on convincing users to take them seriously.
